verdict.rationale: Supabase documents automated daily backups for Pro/Team/Enterprise plans and a PITR add-on with 'up to seconds' granularity restore (supabase-docs-40, supabase-supp-backups-pitr), which is solid first-party evidence. However, a concrete real-world incident (Val Town's migration postmortem) shows nightly pg_dump backups caused write-contention outages on a write-heavy workload, prompting Supabase's own CEO to admit the issue and announce moving customers toward PITR and adding backup controls — directly contradicting the smooth 'reliable automated backups' claim in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification that PITR itself performs reliably at scale, and confirmation that the backup/write-contention issue has been fully resolved across all plans.
